Do this when the Scope is complete, before the Specification is written.

1. Score the six impact dimensions with your commissioner in the
   [Analytical Assurance Decision Tool spreadsheet]({{< var decision-tool >}}), which describes each
   dimension at each level. Score each from Level 1 to Level 4 and take the highest. Opening it needs
   an NHSBSA account with access to the Analytical Quality and Assurance site.
2. **The work is Business Critical if any one dimension scores Level 4.**
3. Keep Level 4 for a material consequence. The tool says: "Publication status, Board
   consideration, Official Statistics designation, media interest, national visibility, FOI
   disclosure, ministerial interest or parliamentary scrutiny do not by themselves justify a Level 4
   score." Score those under public visibility and reach.
4. If you and your commissioner disagree, escalate to the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead.
5. Save the completed Analytical Assurance Decision Tool and attach it to the Specification. Record
   a no as well as a yes.
6. Check whether the Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard applies to any algorithmic tool in the work. It does if the tool:
   - has a significant influence on a decision-making process with public effect, or
   - interacts directly with the general public.

   Record the answer either way. [Algorithmic transparency and AI](/guidance/09-resources/r12-algorithmic-transparency-and-ai.qmd#check-whether-your-tool-needs-a-transparency-record) has the test.
